Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. description:
Hacksaw Markets is a B2B prediction-market platform that operators can use to offer prediction markets under their own brands. As the Head of Market Risk you will build and lead the market-risk function. You will define the limits, models, monitoring and escalation mechanisms that protect the platform through normal conditions, market stress, data failures and unusual participant behaviour.
What you will own

• Develop the risk framework across exposure, liquidity, concentration, volatility, settlement and counterparties.

• Set risk appetite, limits, triggers and escalation protocols for markets, participants and liquidity providers.

• Build real-time dashboards and early-warning indicators with data, quantitative and engineering teams.

• Design stress tests for extreme outcomes, correlated events, rapid information shocks and market closures.

• Review new market categories, contract structures and liquidity programmes before approval.

• Lead incident response for limit breaches, pricing anomalies, data failures and disorderly markets.

What you bring

• 10+ years in market risk, trading risk, exchange risk, clearing or quantitative risk.

• Deep understanding of electronic trading, liquidity, exposure measurement, limit systems and stress testing.

• Experience building or materially improving risk frameworks, models and management reporting.

• Strong quantitative judgment when models and real-world conditions diverge.

• Clear cross-functional communication and calm leadership during high-pressure events.

Why Hacksaw Markets

• A genuine build-stage mandate with direct influence over product, operating model and culture.

• An ambitious team supported by established technology, operating experience and long-term capital.

• The opportunity to help create trusted infrastructure for a category moving rapidly into the mainstream.

Ready to apply?
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant market, system, product or operational challenge you have owned.

title: Asset Manager
description:
Portfolio & Asset Management

• Manage a high-volume portfolio of residential REO assets across multiple markets nationwide.

• Develop and execute disposition strategies designed to maximize investor returns while meeting client performance objectives.

• Monitor portfolio performance metrics, service level agreements (SLAs), timelines, and key operational benchmarks.

• Analyze market conditions, inventory trends, property performance, and buyer demand to optimize pricing and sales strategies.

• Provide regular reporting, forecasting, and recommendations to clients and leadership regarding asset performance and market conditions.

Property Oversight & Value Optimization

• Evaluate asset-specific opportunities to increase net recovery through repairs, renovations, occupancy strategies, and targeted marketing initiatives.

• Review and approve property budgets, vendor recommendations, preservation costs, and capital improvement requests.

• Partner with property management, field services, and vendor networks to ensure assets are maintained, secured, and positioned for sale while minimizing expenses and liability exposure.

• Identify and escalate asset-related risks, compliance issues, operational challenges, and process improvements.

Sales & Disposition Management

• Oversee the disposition process from pre-listing through closing, ensuring timely execution and compliance with client requirements.

• Determine appropriate marketing channels, including traditional MLS listings, online auction offerings, and bulk sale strategies.

• Evaluate offers, negotiate contract terms, secure required approvals, and facilitate successful transaction closings.

• Collaborate with sales, marketing, and product teams to increase asset visibility and drive buyer engagement.

Valuation & Market Analysis

• Review broker price opinions (BPOs), appraisals, comparative market analyses, and valuation reports to support pricing decisions.

• Partner with valuation providers and appraisal teams to reconcile property values and challenge assumptions when appropriate.

• Conduct financial and market analysis to support strategic recommendations and portfolio planning.

Client & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as a trusted advisor for investors, clients, servicing partners, brokers, and buyers throughout the asset lifecycle.

• Maintain proactive communication regarding portfolio performance, asset strategy, market conditions, and transaction status.

• Develop strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

• Support client meetings, portfolio reviews, and business development initiatives as needed.

Systems & Compliance

• Maintain accurate asset records, documentation, and transaction activity within Equator and other asset management platforms.

• Ensure compliance with investor guidelines, regulatory requirements, company policies, and established procedures.

• Monitor foreclosure timelines, title issues, and transaction milestones to mitigate delays and reduce risk.

Required Experience

• 3+ years of experience in REO asset management, default servicing, real estate disposition, or related real estate operations.

• Experience managing institutional or large-scale residential real estate portfolios.

• Proven experience negotiating real estate transactions and managing assets through disposition.

Knowledge & Skills

• Strong knowledge of foreclosure, REO, loss mitigation, title, escrow, and residential real estate transaction processes.

• Working knowledge of HUD, FHA, VA, GSE, and investor servicing requirements.

• Understanding of real estate auction platforms and disposition strategies, including online auction sales.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret market trends, property valuations, and financial data.

• Excellent negotiation, communication, relationship management, and problem-solving abilities.

• Proficiency with Microsoft

DriiveMe est la plateforme leader européen du convoyage de véhicules. Chaque mois, plus de 20 000 missions rémunérées sont proposées à notre communauté de chauffeurs et convoyeurs indépendants partout en France.
Les grands acteurs de l’automobile font confiance à DriiveMe pour déplacer leurs véhicules : Stellantis, Aramisauto, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar , et bien d’autres.
Partout en France, des centaines de sociétés ont besoin de déplacer des véhicules d’un point A à un point B. Elles publient chaque jour leurs besoins sur DriiveMe afin de proposer ces missions à la communauté DriiveMe Partenaire.
En quoi consiste une mission DriiveMe ?
C’est simple : en tant que chauffeur indépendant, vous conduisez un véhicule d’un point A vers un point B. Voici comment ça fonctionne :

• Vous créez votre compte sur

• Vous accédez aux missions disponibles dans votre région.

• Vous consultez le trajet, la rémunération et les conditions de chaque mission.

• Vous réservez en quelques clics les missions que vous souhaitez réaliser.

• Le jour de la mission, vous récupérez le véhicule au point de départ et le livrez au point d’arrivée.

• Une fois la mission terminée et validée, vous recevez votre paiement automatiquement sous 10 jours.

Pourquoi devenir chauffeur indépendant avec DriiveMe Partenaire ?

• Complément de revenus : chaque mission est rémunérée, avec un prix connu à l’avance.

• Organisation flexible : vous choisissez librement les missions que vous souhaitez effectuer.

• Frais de route pris en charge : carburant et péages sont remboursés selon les conditions de la mission.

• Plateforme simple et intuitive : consultation, réservation et suivi des missions en ligne.

• Missions partout en France : de nouvelles opportunités sont publiées chaque jour.

Combien suis-je rémunéré ?
Votre chiffre d'affaires dépend du nombre de missions que vous choisissez de réaliser.
Chaque mission dispose d’une rémunération spécifique, définie selon le trajet, le nombre de kilomètres et la complexité du transport.
Avant de réserver une mission, vous connaissez les informations essentielles : lieu de départ, lieu d’arrivée, rémunération et conditions de prise en charge . Vous êtes libre de réserver uniquement les missions qui vous conviennent.
Profil recherché

• être indépendant ou prêt à le devenir ;

• être sérieux, ponctuel et rigoureux ;

title: Staff Accountant - Restaurant Accounting Services
description:
Tablespoon is a unique blend of accountants, financial consultants, and former restaurant operators who eat, sleep, and breathe the restaurant industry. By combining top shelf accounting services with the latest cloud-based technology, we help multi-unit restaurant owners, operators, and CFOs increase profits and drive business growth.
Why choose Tablespoon

•
Growth. Through one-on-one mentoring, training, and ongoing feedback, you'll develop the skills and experience necessary to advance your career goals.

•
Opportunity to make an impact . Our solutions help transform the way our clients work, enabling more healthy and sustainable growth.

•
Culture of innovation . As a small but rapidly growing firm, we operate more like a startup than a traditional CPA or consulting firm. Innovation, agility, and continuous improvement are at our core.

About the role
As a staff accountant in our Client Accounting Services (CAS) group, you will gain hands-on experience with the complete accounting cycle for a group of assigned clients, using modern, cloud-based accounting software and reporting tools. Day to day tasks will include reconciling accounts, assisting with A/P, troubleshooting account-related problems, and communicating with clients to resolve questions.
What you’ll do

• Perform daily bank account reconciliations for multiple assigned clients

• Review, analyze, and post restaurant daily sales information

• Proactively research and resolve exceptions or variances in daily sales and bank activity

• Assist with accounts payable, including coding invoices and applying payments

• Correspond with client vendors to resolve account issues

• Prepare journal entries with appropriate support

• Prepare monthly sales tax returns

• Communicate with clients to obtain missing information, resolve questions, and provide general support for client inquiries

• Provide exceptional customer service to client personnel and internal team

Requirements
What you’ll need

• Bachelor’s degree in accounting or equivalent (demonstrated) work experience

• Restaurant/hospitality industry experience, ideally in a role with P&L responsibility

• Prior experience with Sage Intacct or similar cloud accounting software is a plus

• A customer service mentality and “whatever it takes” attitude to ensuring client satisfaction

• Exceptional time management skills, attention to detail, and follow through

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Positive attitude, team-focused work style, and innate desire to help others

• Absolute commitment to integrity and protecting client confidentiality

Since Tablespoon is a virtual firm and this is a remote position, the successful candidate will also need:

• A secure place to work from home with no interruptions

• A reliable high-speed internet connection

• Ability to work independently during defined "business hours" with little supervision

• Ability to self-manage competing priorities and deadlines

• Strong technology skills and experience working with modern business SaaS applications and communication tools (Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Box, etc.)

• Must be comfortable communicating and meeting with clients and team members in a virtual environment (including frequent video meetings)

• Ability to travel once or twice a year for team meetings

Benefits
The salary range for this position is $55,000 to $70,000 annually, plus bonus potential.
This position also offers comprehensive benefits including medical, 401k, and PTO, as well as hands-on training and opportunities for advancement.
Tablespoon LLC is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
For more information about our firm, please visit our website at www.tbsp.com.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, LLM Inference Optimization
locationText: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Berlin, Germany; London +3 more
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role Summary

Nebius Token Factory is building production-grade inference for open-source, customer, and internally optimized models. This role owns the path from model artifact to fast, reliable, cost-efficient endpoint. The work sits at the intersection of model internals, inference engines, serving architecture, benchmarking, and production deployment.

 

What You Will Do

•
Own a platform-level optimization pillar such as quantization, speculative decoding, KV -cache optimization, engine selection, or long-context serving.

•
Create reusable evaluation, benchmarking, and rollout frameworks across multiple model families.

•
Provide technical direction to MLEs, Applied Scientists, GPU kernel engineers, and infrastructure engineers on shared performance goals.

•
Optimize LLM and VLM endpoints for latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.

•
Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, or similar systems.

•
Build and productionize model-compression workflows, including quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.

•
Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV -cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.

•
Build reproducible benchmark harnesses for TTFT , TPOT , tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.

•
Partner with GPU kernel engineers and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.

•
Write clear design docs, performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.

Required Qualifications

•
Strong Python and PyTorch engineering skills.

•
Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM , or high-throughput transformer inference systems.

•
Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference stack such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or equivalent internal systems.

•
Strong understanding of transformer inference bottlenecks, including KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.

•
Ability to reason quantitatively about latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and cost tradeoffs.

•
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.

Preferred Qualifications

•
Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8 , INT8 , INT4 , NVFP4 , MXFP4 , AWQ , GPTQ , SmoothQuant, or related techniques.

•
Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or other inference acceleration methods.

•
Experience with agentic workloads, including tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.

•
CUDA or Triton familiarity, even if the role is not primarily a kernel-engineering role.

•
Open-source contributions to vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache

description:
About Us:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a true startup Operations person. Good onboarding is what makes our merchants set up for success. From the first meeting, the go-live to working and growing together - this person will own the onboarding process and make it all happen. This role is for someone who likes working with the product, becoming an expert in it and teaching others.

Your day-to-day will be a mix of hands-on ops, project management, customer communication and problem solving. We are reshaping the future of hospitality tech, and this role is at the forefront of it.

What You’ll Do:

Our Operations happen on a restaurant floor, in a lively neighbourhood, at a busy bar - we operate in the city:

- Run restaurant onboarding: train, connect and implement together with the restaurant team

- Problem-solve for our merchants on the ground while running live operations

- Support restaurants after the go live and make sure that Tebi adds value to their business long-term

- Find opportunities for improvement in our process, materials and systems

- Continue investing in our relationship with our merchants to make sure they are happy with our product and growing as a business

- Identify product and process gaps and bring it to internal central teams such as product, engineering and central operations

What You’ll Need:

- You are a creative problem solver who enjoys interacting with hospitality businesses

- You are empathetic towards our merchants and curious about their business

- You can juggle multiple things at once and bring structure

- Curious about the product, want to be an expert in Tebi system and can apply your knowledge

- Good communication - you are great at proactive contact and managing expectations

- Being comfortable with high-pace environments: both the hospitality flow and the startup day-to-day

- Interest in data, process improvement and automation

- Flexibility in working hours that fit our merchants’ needs and ensuring a healthy balance

- At least 2-4 years of experience in hospitality, early startup operations, fast-paced account management or customer operations

- You are comfortable working in both English and Spanish

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Flexible Time-off

- Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Deployment Strategist - Germany Forward Deployed
description:
NOTE: Although this position is in support of our US Government work, this role is located in Wiesbaden, Germany.
 
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

What We're About
 
At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around leveraging data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.

If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you.
 
What We Do
 
As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most challenging problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.

Deployment Strategists are do-ers who immerse themselves in our customers' most intricate workflows, partner with customer teams and explore the data, and dive into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In this role, the problems you'll tackle will require a curious and analytical mindset, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user empathy to ultimately empower our customers to make better decisions.

Salary
 
The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $110,000 - $170,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.
 
Benefits
 
• Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance
• Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance
• Commuter benefits
• If hired to deploy via SOFA to Japan, you will be eligible for the standard new hire relocation benefit if you need to relocate > 50 miles for the job
• Support for home and host tax returns and tax equalization
• Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based
• 2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs)
• 10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year
• Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events
• Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents
• Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation
• Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child
• Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan

title: Finance Manager
description:
ABOUT VERTO

At Verto, we're on a mission to democratise global finance and empower businesses in Emerging Markets to reach the world. Founded by British-Nigerian entrepreneurs Ola Oyetayo and Anthony Oduu, our roots in Africa provided a firsthand understanding of the significant challenges businesses face with cross-border payments, ranging from illiquid currencies and high fees to slow transactions. This deep-rooted insight is why Africa remains a core focus, as we're committed to bridging the gap between emerging and developed markets and fostering global economic growth.

What started as an FX solution for the Nigerian Naira has evolved into a market-leading platform, enabling thousands of businesses to seamlessly transfer billions of dollars annually. We believe that where you do business shouldn’t determine your success or ability to scale. We're creating equal access to the easy payment and liquidity solutions that are already a given in developed markets.

We're not alone in realising this crucial need; we're backed by world-class investors including Y-Combinator, Quona, and MEVP. With Verto receiving the Milken-Motsepe Prize, appearing on CNBCs list of fastest growing UK companies, the Deloitte Fast 50 and Sifted’s fastest-growing UK tech companies, we are building a seamless cross-border payment future.

Join us as we continue to grow and transform global finance.

ROLE OVERVIEW

This is a standout opportunity for an ambitious accountant to accelerate their career within one of the fastest-growing cross-border payments fintechs. As Verto expands into new markets and launches new products, you will step into a role defined by genuine ownership and visibility. You will lead critical workstreams across management reporting, financial operations, and process optimisation, directly influencing decision-making and company growth. We are seeking a versatile and analytical Finance Manager to join our high-performing Finance team.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Financial Reporting and Control

1. Own the month-end close process, delivering accurate, timely and insight-driven management accounts that enable leadership to make informed commercial decisions.

2. Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations to strengthen financial integrity and enhance audit readiness.

3. Produce high-quality financial statements and reporting packs, improving visibility over entity-level performance across global jurisdictions.

Financial and KPI analysis

1. Perform in-depth financial and KPI analysis to explain performance drivers, support revenue analytics and influence strategic planning.

2. Reconcile financial and KPI data at scale, ensuring accuracy for internal reporting, external audits, and regulatory requirements.

Compliance, Operations and Audit

1. Oversee compliance-related financial operations, helping ensure Verto meets obligations across regulatory licences, tax, and statutory filings.

2. Manage external professional services teams (internal and external auditors, accountants, tax advisors), ensuring high-quality outputs and efficient collaboration.

3. Lead AR process improvements, helping to reduce aged debt, streamline billing, and protect revenue.

4. Support statutory and financial audits end-to-end, strengthening Verto’s control environment and reducing audit issues over time.

Process Improvement and Scalability

1. Identify and implement automation and process enhancements to reduce manual work, improve data accuracy, and create a scalable finance infrastructure as Verto grows.

2. Develop and document accounting policies, strengthening governance and standardising finance processes across global entities.

3. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, Data, Operations, Treasury) to improve workflow efficiency and ensure finance is embedded across business processes.

WHAT YOU NEED

- You must be a fully qualified Accountant (ACCA/ACA/CIMA).

- 3+ years of experience in Financial Services, Fintech, Payments, Bankin

title: UX Analyst (Product Workflows) | Field Operations SaaS | Remote (LATAM) 🎨
description:
Company Overview
Our client is a software company that helps property managers inspect properties and turn what they find into clear, shareable reports. Someone opens the app on their phone, walks a property capturing photos, video, and voice notes even with no signal, since it works offline and syncs later, then reviews everything and runs reporting on the web. It plugs into the property-management systems teams already use, so the data doesn't sit in a silo. They've been at this since 2014, profitable and self-funded the whole way, and today more than 20,000 people use it across the U.S. and 20-plus countries, together capturing over 100 million inspection photos. There's even a new AI feature that turns spoken notes into a finished report on its own, so an inspector can walk a property, say what they see, and skip the typing.
Your Role
You own how work moves through the product from the first step to the last: the steps, the logic, the states, and the handoffs between the phone in the field and the review screen back at the office. You'll map how property managers actually work, find where a flow gets confusing or breaks, and redesign it so the next person doesn't have to think about it. There's another designer on the team who leans visual and component-level, so you lean process and flow, and together you cover the whole surface. This is a design role about how work behaves, not visual polish. You report to the Head of Engineering, and what you design gets built instead of sitting in a backlog.
You'll

• Map property management workflows end to end, from field capture to sync to review to report

• Talk to the people who live in a workflow, then redesign it with fewer steps

• Write the logic, branches, and edge cases behind each flow so engineering builds it right the first time

• Design the offline and retry states so users always know what's happening when the signal drops

• Prototype in Figma and check it with quick usability runs

• Hand engineering annotated specs (states, rules, microcopy) they can build from with little back-and-forth

• Review builds, log precise issues, and confirm the fixes before sign-off

You Bring

• Experience designing complex, multi-step workflows (B2B, SaaS, operations, or field tools). We care more about how the flows in your portfolio hold up than about a year count, and we'll happily hire someone earlier in their career who clearly has the instinct for this

• A portfolio that shows the whole path, problem to mapping to logic to final, not just polished screens

• Systems thinking: you design for the states, branches, permissions, errors, and empty cases, not just the happy path

• You write clear flow documentation and specs engineering can build straight from

• Strong Figma for mapping, prototyping, and handoff

• AI fluency: you use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Figma AI to move through options and specs faster without lowering quality

• A working handle on accessibility (contrast, tap targets, text size, focus order)

Bonus Points

• Service design or process mapping (journey maps, service blueprints, workflow diagrams)

• Experience designing information-dense web UIs (tables, filtering, bulk actions, reporting dashboards)

• Background in workflow-heavy B2B products: property management, field services, logistics, or operations tooling

• Comfort using analytics to confirm a redesigned flow actually performs better

What's Offered

• Fully remote across LATAM, around 40 hours a week, flexible for the right person, with a few hours of overlap during U.S. Pacific business hours

• Paid weekly in USD as a contractor

• Up to 20 days of paid time off a year (10 vacation days plus 10 local public holidays)

title: Growth (French speaking)

For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand - builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.

At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!

THE OPPORTUNITY

Column's Growth team is focused on managing our highly strategic customer relationships. As a member of the Growth team, you’ll be responsible for building and overseeing all aspects of our customer management while acting as a trusted partner, advisor and advocate for a wide variety of customers. You will also be in charge of designing and implementing the strategy, processes, and content needed to help us scale this key function.

This role has a unique international focus, helping build one of Column's most strategic expansion initiatives from the ground up. At least have of your work will be dedicated to building and managing partnerships with banks across Africa. The rest of your time will go to working with Column's core fintech partners.

Column's Growth team is not your typical Customer Success or Account Management team in that Column is a critical, often existential, partner for our customers, our customer relationships are deeply collaborative and complex, and each customer contributes meaningfully to our revenue. We're therefore looking for team members who are analytical, demonstrate great critical thinking, and have experience managing very strategic relationships.

This role is highly cross-functional and collaborative, partnering closely with Column’s Executive, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Compliance, and Correspondent Banking teams to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly, that we can anticipate and address both issues and opportunities for growth, and that these relationships are healthy and mutually beneficial. You’ll also represent the voice of the customer to help inform Column's strategy, including the product roadmap, go-to-market motions and more.

Success in this role also means having a desire to become an expert on the Financial Technology space and on how companies partner with Column (our customers include many key industry players such as Brex and Carta).

This role reports to the Head of Growth and is an in-person role, where you’ll be expected to work out of our San Francisco Presidio-based office 3+ days a week.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Help establish our customer-facing strategy, processes, playbooks, systems and best practices. Identify patterns and build repeatability at every step

- Manage all aspects of a customer’s relationship with Column, from onboarding and implementation to ongoing management and expansion of the account

- Onboard and manage our emerging markets bank partners: Serve as the day-to-day lead for banks across Africa. Guide them through onboarding and own the ongoing relationship once they’re live.

- Build and nurture relationships across various functions within a customer's organization, identifying and creating advocates wherever you go, and helping find new use cases for partnering with Column

- Proactively identify challenges and opportunities for growth, and collaborate with internal and extern

We run on-call and incident management tooling, build observability and automation, and create the playbooks that help teams detect and recover from production issues. We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer 2 who is passionate about building resilient, highly available systems that scale to meet the demands of the core systems powering Lattice. You will work closely with platform engineers, product developers, and field operations to proactively identify reliability risks, respond to incidents, and help owning teams improve the operational excellence of our software platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Build and improve monitoring, observability, and alerting systems to detect reliability issues early and make them easier to diagnose across the Lattice platform

• Participate in on-call rotations, triage production incidents, and coordinate response and escalation with the teams that own affected services

• Contribute to blameless postmortems and work with owning teams to turn incident learnings into systemic improvements

• Build and maintain shared reliability tooling and automation that reduce toil, surface risks, and help teams make safer changes

• Partner with service owners to identify Kubernetes patch and version risks, develop maintenance plans, and track owner-led updates to completion

• Help service teams define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budgets to balance feature velocity with reliability

• Partner with software engineering teams on reliability patterns such as graceful degradation and circuit breakers

• Contribute to capacity planning and performance testing with owning teams to help systems handle growth and peak operational demands

• Create runbooks, documentation, and training materials that help teams operate production systems effectively

• Partner with software engineering teams to improve deployment safety through progressive rollouts, automated testing, and rollback capabilities

• Work with service owners to incorporate security best practices and compliance controls in production environments handling sensitive defense data

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 2-4 years of engineering experience, including 2+ years in SRE, production operations, or infrastructure engineering

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Job Title: Account Executive, UK Public Sector

 

Reporting to: Director of Sales, UK & Ireland

Direct Reports: None

Location: UK (remote)

Travel expectations: Approximately 50%

 

Your Impact

As an Account Executive at Axon, you will play a key role in helping police forces across the UK adopt technology that saves lives, reduces risk to officers and the public, and enhances transparency and public trust. You will be supporting the adoption of Axon's ecosystem of products - including body-worn and in-car cameras, TASER devices, and cloud-based software platforms including our digital evidence management system - across forces in the UK. Your success will be measured by your ability to build and maintain senior-level relationships, drive large, complex opportunities through public sector procurement, and align Axon's solutions with the mission-critical needs of UK policing. This is a quota-carrying, external field position.

 

At Axon, our goal is to make each individual feel valued for their contribution to the company's mission to protect life. We are looking for intelligent people who want to do remarkable things. We strive to create an environment where people can succeed and enjoy coming to work every day. Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. You will constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

 

What You'll Do

Develop and Execute Account Strategies: Create comprehensive account strategies that align Axon's solutions with the mission-critical needs of UK police forces, focusing on officer safety, operational efficiency and digital transformation. This will require close collaboration with other internal members of the account team(s).

Drive Complex Sales Engagements: Manage long sales cycles, leading to high-value, multi-year agreements with forces and police-led collaboratives. Facilitate discovery meetings, present Axon's value propositions, and lead customer negotiations.

Help increase market share and achieve Axon's strategic objectives by maximising revenue and customer satisfaction within your designated forces and regions.

Support Public Safety Innovation: Partner with internal teams to present Axon's innovative public safety technologies - such as TASER 10, Axon Body 4, Axon Fleet, Axon Evidence, Axon Respond, Axon Fusus and Axon VR training - demonstrating how these solutions transform force operations and support national productivity and efficiency priorities.

Manage Customer Relationships: Cultivate relationships with both executive and operational leaders within police forces - including Chief Constables, Deputy Chief Constables, Police and Crime Commissioners and their offices, Chief Finance Officers, Heads of Digital/IT and operational commanders. Champion Public Safety Outcomes: Position Axon as a key enabler of UK policing priorities, helping forces meet their operational and safety goals while enhancing transparency, accountability and public confidence.

Collaborate with Internal Teams: Work closely with Axon's customer success, engineering and programme management teams to ensure that customer projects are delivered on time and that forces derive measurable value from Axon's solutions.

description:
Role Title: Visual Content Evaluator
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Visual Content Evaluators to support a customer initiative focused on enhancing the quality of AI-generated images. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Upload original images you own that strictly follow provided project specifications.

• Compare each original image with its AI-generated counterpart, performing meticulous, side-by-side assessments.

• Detect and flag common AI image artifacts such as warped hands, smudged surfaces, inconsistent shadows, broken patterns, or misshapen text.

• Compose clear, accurate, and concise written descriptions for each identified issue, pinpointing exact locations within the images.

• Consistently apply a high standard of quality assurance by following detailed project guidelines and prioritizing accuracy over speed.

• Maintain thorough, constructive feedback throughout your evaluations, ensuring actionable insights for model improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

• Based in the United States (non-negotiable project requirement).

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, producing error-free feedback and detailed image notes.

• Keen visual acuity with a proven ability to detect even subtle differences between similar images.

• Background in photography, digital imaging, graphic design, photo editing, or a closely related discipline, with the precise vocabulary to describe technical visual issues.

• Understanding of AI image generation processes and typical failure points.

• Demonstrated experience in image evaluation, data annotation, comparison, or similar visual quality assurance contexts.

• Reliable, detail-oriented approach with a commitment to careful, comprehensive review on every assignment.

title: Information System Security Officer (ISSO)
description:
Job Title: Information System Security Officer (ISSO)Job Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: NoneType of Travel: None* * * The Opportunity:

CACI is searching for an Information System Security Officer (ISSO) to support the DHS Headquarters. As an Information System Security Officer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the security and compliance of DHS HQ's information systems. You will work in a dynamic environment, collaborating with IT system owners, stakeholders, and cybersecurity professionals to implement and maintain robust security controls. Your efforts will directly contribute to safeguarding DHS's mission-critical systems and data. The ISSO will serve as the single point of contact on all systems security matters, leading cybersecurity engineering efforts for assigned Program Management Organizations with direct support to the Compliance Branch Lead. This includes spearheading systems' ATO efforts and maintaining a security posture in compliance with FISMA, DHS 4300 Series, NIST, and DHS and Component Directives. The ISSO will execute complete Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities for Authority to Operate (ATO) decisions and ensure all security documentation is kept up to date.

Responsibilities:

The ISSO will execute complete Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities for Authority to Operate (ATO) decisions including system categorization, security control selection and implementation, self-assessments, POA&M development, and continuous monitoring. This position requires developing and maintaining System Security Plans (SSPs) including control baselines, inheritance, Business Impact Analyses, implementation statements, technical and system descriptions, and hardware and software inventories. The ISSO will create and maintain Configuration Management Plans, conduct Security Impact Analyses, approve Change Requests, and document the security impact of configuration changes. Responsibilities include developing and testing Contingency Plans and Incident Response Plans to ensure business continuity, as well as conducting annual risk assessments, supporting security assessments, and vulnerability assessments across assigned systems. The position involves advising system owners and senior executives on all cybersecurity matters and developing remediation work plans for assessment and/or audit findings. The ISSO will maintain Hardware and Software Inventory Lists and conduct FISMA Scorecard Analysis. The ISSO will ensure proper access controls are implemented for system access, track and suggest technologies, processes, and practices designed to protect networks, devices, programs, and data from malicious attack, damage, or unauthorized access, and research and maintain proficiency in tools, techniques, countermeasures, and trends in computer and network vulnerabilities, data hiding, and network and device security and encryption.

Qualifications:

Required:
- U.S. Citizenship required

• DHS EOD suitability or Current DHS EOD preferred
- BS/BA + 8 years of applicable experience in information security
- 7+ years of experience in information security
- Demonstrated expertise in RMF, Information Security processes, audits, tools, implementation, FISMA, NIST, IT security
- Experience developing System Security Plans, POA&Ms, and Configuration Management Plans
- Knowledge of NIST SP 800-37, NIST SP 800-53, and DHS 4300 Series requirements

Desired:

- One of the following Information Assurance Technician (IAT) Level III qualifications:
- Certified Information System Security Professional (CISSP)
- Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
- CompTIA Advanced Security Practitioner (CASP+)
- Previous DHS experience
- Experience with CSAM, RegScale, eMASS, or similar GRC tools
- Experience supporting emergency operations or disaster response missions
- Knowledge of cloud security and FedRAMP authorization

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. • Design, build, and maintain scalable distributed backend systems capable of handling high-volume traffic from hundreds of thousands of devices deployed globally.

• Practical experience using BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker to analyze commercial performance and communicate insights

• Strong understanding of CRM pipeline data, including opportunity structures, data hygiene, forecasting and reporting

• Experience producing forecast and pipeline reports for senior leadership, translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations

• Advanced English proficiency

• Experience in pricing, deal desk, discounting or margin analysis

• Experience in EdTech or subscription services sales cycles

title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs. What are you going to do? Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack. Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

 

Role Summary

The Manufacturing Lead is responsible for supervising and coordinating the activities of the manufacturing team to ensure production schedules are met and products are manufactured to the highest quality standards. This role involves managing day-to-day operations, leading continuous improvement initiatives, and maintaining a safe and efficient work environment.

 

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

Support Manufacturing Supervisor:

• Assist the Manufacturing Supervisor in coordinating the activities of the manufacturing team to ensure efficient workflow.

• Monitor production schedules and help adjust assignments as necessary to meet production goals.

• Ensure production processes are carried out in accordance with company policies and safety standards.

• Quickly address and resolve production-related issues, minimizing downtime and ensuring smooth operations.

Team Leadership:

• Lead, mentor, and motivate the production team, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.

• Assign tasks to team members based on their skills and the needs of the production line.

• Track and evaluate the performance of individual team members and the overall production line.

Training and Development:

• Assist in onboarding and training new employees on manufacturing processes, safety protocols, and company policies.

• Foster a positive and collaborative work environment.

Quality Control:

• Oversee the quality of products throughout the production process to ensure they meet company standards.

• Implement quality control procedures and conduct regular inspections to identify and rectify defects.

Continuous Improvement:

• Identify inefficiencies in the production process and suggest improvements to enhance productivity and reduce costs.

• Implement approved changes and monitor their effectiveness.

• Report any equipment malfunctions or breakdowns immediately and assist in troubleshooting.

• Promote and enforce adherence to 5S principles, ensuring that these practices become part of the company culture.

Safety and Compliance:

• Promote a safe working environment by enforcing safety policies and procedures.

• Support regular safety inspections

title: Аналітик (регулярна та регуляторна звітність)
description:
У команду Київстар шукаємо аналітика/-иню, який/-а відповідатиме за підготовку регулярної звітності, аналітичних матеріалів для керівництва та взаємодію з українськими й європейськими телеком-регуляторами. Нам потрібна людина, яка любить цифри, вміє бачити за ними закономірності та перетворювати дані на зрозумілі висновки 😉
Що треба робити?
Готувати та оновлювати регулярні звіти й дашборди для внутрішніх замовників
Створювати презентації для керівництва, візуалізувати дані та формулювати ключові висновки
Формувати та подавати звітність для українського регулятора НКЕК і європейських регуляторних органів
Опрацьовувати ad hoc запити від бізнесу: збирати дані, проводити аналіз і презентувати результати
Перевіряти повноту та коректність статистичних даних, знаходити розбіжності й координувати їх виправлення з власниками даних
Взаємодіяти з командами IT, фінансів, комерційним та юридичним підрозділами, підтримувати документацію щодо методології розрахунків і джерел даних
Ви - наш метч, якщо...
Маєте вищу освіту за напрямами економіки, статистики, математики, інформатики або суміжними спеціальностями
Маєте досвід аналітичної роботи від 2 років, бажано у телекомунікаціях, фінансах або регульованих галузях
Впевнено володієте Excel (зведені таблиці, формули, Power Query) та SQL (Oracle)
Працювали з BI-інструментами: Power BI, Tableau або аналогічними
Вмієте створювати структуровані та зрозумілі презентації у PowerPoint
Уважні до деталей, відповідальні в роботі з даними та дотримуєтеся дедлайнів
Володієте українською мовою на високому рівні та англійською від B1
Буде круто, якщо...
Маєте досвід підготовки регуляторної звітності
Знаєте основні телеком-індикатори: ARPU, churn, трафік, покриття тощо
Володієте Python на базовому рівні та можете використовувати його для автоматизації й перевірки даних
Чому Київстар?
Гнучкий графік роботи, гібридний формат
Бонуси за досягнення цілей (річні чи квартальні - залежить від ролі)
340+ внутрішніх курсів, власна бібліотека, навчальні програми від партнерів
Страхування життя і здоров’я
Програми підтримки працівників та їхніх родин: психологічні, юридичні та ін
Безбар’єрний простір для роботи та розвитку
Проєкти на підтримку захисників, ветеранів та їхніх родин
Компенсація витрат на мобільний зв’язок
Шукаєте команду, де ваш внесок та експертизу цінують? Це - про Київстар, долучайтеся 😉

title: Site Reliability Consultant
description:
Why Pythian :

At Pythian , we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian , a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

Pythian is building a next-generation Site Reliability Engineering team, and we’re looking for talented, motivated engineers who thrive in fast-paced, problem-solving environments. As an SRE, you’ll design, deploy, and operate large-scale distributed systems across compute, storage, networking, and AI/ML environments. You’ll lead projects from architecture to automation to intelligent monitoring, collaborating with both clients and teammates to build resilient, high-performing infrastructure.

If this is you, and you wonder what it would be like to work at Pythian , reach out to us and find out!

• Troubleshoot complex networking, storage, and system performance issues.

• Partner with AI/ML teams to ensure infrastructure readiness for model training and data pipelines.

• Participate in on-call rotations and postmortem reviews to improve system resilience.

• Experience with Google Cloud , plus IaC tools (Terraform).

• Strong knowledge of microservices, containers ( Kubernetes , Docker), and networking.

• SRE mindset with a focus on automation, scalability, and reliability.

title: Japanese Transcription Expert - Remote | Upto $33/hr
description:
About the job
Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark , General Catalyst , Peter Thiel , Adam D'Angelo , Larry Summers , and Jack Dorsey .
Position: PDF Annotation & Transcription Experts - Japanese
Type: Contract
Compensation: $34/hour
Location: Remote
Role Responsibilities

• Source documents by finding publicly accessible Japanese PDFs with multimodal elements and record their origins.

• Annotate structure by identifying and bounding every meaningful region, assigning component types and reading-order indices.

• Record relationships by linking regions to their parent components like figures or tables.

• Transcribe faithfully, reproducing all text exactly as it appears, including kanji , hiragana , katakana , and handwritten content.

• Capture page metadata such as language, document type, source, page dimensions, and flags for tables and handwriting.

• Review a colleague's work, ensuring tasks are reviewed end-to-end by a second Japanese expert.

Qualifications

Must-Have

• Native Japanese speaker with full command of kanji , hiragana , and katakana .

• Professional experience in interpretation, journalism, transcription, translation, or editorial work.

• Exact character-level accuracy, prioritizing precision over speed.

• Systematic approach, applying a taxonomy consistently across documents.

• Comfort with unfamiliar layouts like vertical text and multi-column newspapers.

Preferred

• Experience with AI training data annotation, labeling, or bilingual evaluation.

• Skills in transcription and localization, including MTPE , subtitling, and OCR correction.

• Document production experience such as typesetting, copy-editing, or proofreading.

• Knowledge of script and encoding, including Unicode normalization and Japanese input methods.

036135 Network Security Administrator (Open) Job Description:
The Sr. Engineer, Network Operations provides technical expertise in the management of LAN/WAN networks. This role is responsible for the implementation, support, and evaluation of network infrastructure and leads efforts related to testing, quality assurance, configuration, installation, and support to ensure the seamless and timely delivery of network services. The position requires close collaboration with the broader team and active participation in day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate is hands-on, adaptable, and willing to step in as needed to support operational priorities.
Additionally, the Sr. Engineer, Network Operations supports network-related activities associated with mergers and acquisitions (M&A), as needed.

Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with network team members to ensure the smooth and reliable operation of network infrastructure, supporting business objectives and processes.

• Partner with team members and business stakeholders to define network requirements, support business goals, and resolve technical challenges.

• Implement and enhance network services and infrastructure to meet evolving business and operational needs.

• Evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of existing systems and processes; develop and implement strategies to improve or optimize them.

• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation related to network configurations, systems, services, and processes.

• Coordinate and execute in-depth testing, including end-user reviews, for modified and new systems.

• Monitor and assess network performance; prepare and deliver performance statistics and reports.

• Support, maintain, and optimize the global Cisco ISE deployment.

• Support, maintain, and optimize the global Cisco SD-WAN deployment.

• Partner with subject matter experts to support and optimize global Palo Alto deployments, including on-premises firewalls and the Prisma Access SASE solution for mobile users and remote networks.

• Assist with daily operations by resolving incidents, fulfilling service requests, and providing technical guidance and knowledge sharing across the team.

• Support network-related integration, transition, and operational activities associated with mergers and acquisitions (M&A), as needed.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience may be considered.

• Typically, 5-10 years of experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure and network security technologies.

• Experience administering LAN/WAN environments in a global or distributed organization.

• Experience with Cisco networking, Cisco ISE, SD-WAN, Palo Alto firewalls, and Prisma Access is strongly preferred.

• Experience with network access control, firewall administration, VPNs, routing, switching, segmentation, and secure remote access.

• Experience supporting manufacturing, operational technology, or geographically distributed environments is a plus.
